issues: [reviewer] index.html:51 — the h1 merges brand + offer into one heading ("Safety Auto Repair - Bothell" then gradient span "Honest repairs, clear pricing"); in Archivo Black at 35px+ it will wrap mid-thought at 360px and the two-tier message gets flattened. Fix: put the brand on line 1 and the gradient accent on a visually separated line below (display:block, smaller size) so hierarchy reads name → offer.

[reviewer] index.html:54-56 — hero CTA row ships three competing actions (Call / Get a Free Quote / Explore Services); no single clear CTA survives. Fix: keep the phone as the lone primary, keep the secondary quote view, and demote "Explore Services" to a plain text link or drop it since it duplicates the nav.

[reviewer] styles.css:24 — .btn-primary uses a brand→brand2 gradient, but the hero background itself ends in brand2 and the badge/accent text also carry gradients; the CTA gets swallowed by the wash behind it. Fix: make the primary button solid (deep navy on orange, or brand2 on navy) so it stands out against the hero.

[reviewer] styles.css:78 — 12px review slider dots are undersized tap targets on mobile (well under 44px). Fix: bump .dot to ~16px with a larger hit area (padding or min-width) at the 760px breakpoint.

praise: Copy is genuinely specific — real street address, phone, 4.8/188 rating, named services, "Diagnostics before dollars" — no filler or welcome-speak; passes the 10-second test easily.
Palette is disciplined and on-brand for a safety/repair shop: deep navy (trust) + one warm orange/gold family, not generic gradient soup.
Motion layer is thoughtful and tasteful — loader, aurora, count-ups, parallax — all properly gated behind prefers-reduced-motion and no-JS fallbacks.
Mobile collapse is tight: hamburger nav, full-width call button, single-column grids, and a mobile-first hero type scale hold up at 360px.
